title: Analysis code for: Nutrition–inflammation gene-expression axes associate with myeloid inflammatory activity but do not predict survival in non-small cell lung cancer: a TCGA transcriptomic analysis
description:
Analysis pipeline for a TCGA pan-cancer RNA-seq study of three a-priori nutrition–inflammation gene-expression axes in non-small cell lung cancer. The three signatures (16 genes each) are prior definitions built as proxies for the components of the advanced lung cancer inflammation index; the study explicitly does not claim equivalence with the clinical index.

Pipeline. Stream subsetting of the UCSC Xena Toil pan-cancer RSEM FPKM compendium to TCGA-LUAD/TCGA-LUSC; reversal of the stored log2(FPKM + 0.001) encoding and Ensembl-to-symbol collapse; ssGSEA single-sample scoring (GSVA 2.x) of the three axes; LASSO-Cox modelling in the LUAD training cohort (glmnet, 10-fold cross-validation); internal hold-out validation with a repeated 7:3 split (100 repetitions) and feature selection performed inside the training set only; cross-histology generalisation to TCGA-LUSC; and three pre-specified sensitivity analyses covering the survival endpoint (OS / DSS / PFI), the feature scheme (three prior axes vs. six real MSigDB pathways vs. 48 single genes) and the training direction (LUAD→LUSC and LUSC→LUAD); and two robustness modules that calibrate every observed association against 1,000 random 16-gene panels per axis under two null models (expression-matched and unconstrained) scored in the same ssGSEA run, and recompute all axis–feature associations as Spearman partial correlations controlling for the ESTIMATE tumour-purity estimate (n = 1,010 matched samples). A second analysis module relates the three axes to the tumour immune microenvironment using pathway-level activity proxies from real MSigDB C5 GO:BP and HALLMARK entries, reported explicitly as activity proxies rather than deconvolution estimates.

Result. The axes associate with myeloid inflammatory activity but do not predict survival: internal hold-out C-index 0.494 (log-rank P = 0.888) and a median repeated-split test C-index of 0.542 (2.5th–97.5th percentile 0.456–0.600). The prognostic result is reported as an honest negative rather than a rescued model.

Reproducibility. All scripts are shipped unmodified except for one hard-coded project root, which relocate.py rewrites on the user's machine. Derived result tables are included so that every reported number can be checked without re-downloading the 720 MB expression matrix. CHECKSUMS.sha256 covers every file in this deposit, and the MSigDB version is pinned by byte-level md5 comparison against the Broad public release archive.

Note. The TCGA expression matrix, the TCGA-CDR clinical table, the sample barcode list and the MSigDB gene sets are third-party public data and are not redistributed here; all accessions, download locations and locally verified fingerprints are listed in DATA_SOURCES.md.
